title: The Grappling Club
gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Alex was a Blackbelt in Brazilian Jiu Jitsu under Josh Griffiths, Alex taught Jiu Jitsu and Submission Grappling for a decade. After teaching at a variety of schools including Clockwork Jiu Jitsu, High Ground Jiu Jitsu, Penn Hills MMA, and Chok Sabai, Alex founded The Grappling Club. A true technician, his ability to teach simply and effectively made him an invaluable asset to the members of the club.
